issues.explanation: The overlay labels this isolated なら as Nなら, but the noun it would condition is not included in the surface. Here 本来なら is an adverbial conditional expression meaning “normally; under ordinary circumstances.”
issues.suggested_fix: Remove the overlay or use the exact surface 本来なら with grammar 本来なら and meaning “normally; under ordinary circumstances.”

issues.explanation: なんとも〜な is not a genuine fixed grammar construction here; なんとも is an adverb modifying 奇妙, while な is the attributive form of the na-adjective 奇妙だ.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace with an overlay on 奇妙な describing the attributive form of a na-adjective, or remove this overlay.

The past meaning is supplied by the following auxiliary た. 知っ is the inflected stem of 知る and should not itself be glossed as “learned.”
